name: apexify.js
description: Advanced server-side canvas rendering, image processing, charts, GIF/video workflows, procedural audio, scenes and templates for Node.js.
author: zenith-79

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:js && npm run build:types && node scripts/verify-dist.cjs
scripts.test:security: node scripts/phase1-security-scan.cjs && node scripts/build-security-fixture.mjs && node tests/security-phase1.cjs
scripts.test:phase3: node scripts/phase3-bypass-scan.cjs && node scripts/build-phase3-fixture.mjs && node tests/phase3-runtime.cjs && node tests/phase3-post.cjs && node tests/phase3-compat.cjs && node tests/phase3-decoded-cache.cjs
scripts.test:phase4: node scripts/phase4-validation-scan.cjs && node scripts/build-phase4-fixture.mjs && node tests/phase4-runtime.cjs && node tests/phase4-public-surfaces.cjs && node tests/phase4-postmerge-regressions.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:security && npm run test:phase3 && npm run test:phase4 && npm run test:phase5
scripts.verify:release: npm run build && npm test && node scripts/verify-packed-package.cjs
